purpose: Expose one consumer-safe Foundation release projection that exists only when the exact immutable binding has a current integrity-verified Layer-60 promotion-closure receipt.
invariants: A raw immutable binding is transition evidence, not a consumer-ready release.
A downstream promoted release exists only while Layer-60 closure is closed, current and integrity verified.
A stale, invalid, open or blocked closure produces no promoted release payload.
The consumer projection carries its own deterministic SHA-256 fingerprint.
Consumer assertions are read-only and grant no release mutation authority.
Runtime readiness is not implied by promotion closure.
New production code may not read the raw current binding outside the explicit control-plane allowlist.
Consumers validate the promoted-release response against the pinned v1 contract before trusting its release identity.
